text:
Technically the proper way to deal with this is to file an internal appeal - as Roberta says, a lawyer is strongly recommended for this, but you can try and do it yourself. However before doing that, I would suggest going to the office ASAP and trying to talk with them face-to-face. Bring documents of the bankruptcy, inability to travel, inability to pay the deposit etc. I have heard of situations where people have been able to negotiate a lower deposit this way, but your mileage may vary.

If that doesn't work, and if there is absolutely no way you can pay the deposit, an appeal is your only option. Please note that an appeal must be submitted within 21 days from the date you received the decision, so if you wish to challenge it, it is very important to act quickly.
